campaign.name: The Hollow Reach
campaign.notice: Two ways into the deep section are known. Neither has been walked all the way in.

inner.label: Uncharted Deep
inner.blurb: Sealed until a Tech-Acquisitor party cut their way in and stopped transmitting. Only the border is mapped; what lies inside gets surveyed as gangs push into it.

gateways.name: The Theta Breach
gateways.notes: A Tech-Acquisitor party cut through here and went in. Contact was lost on the second day. The coordinates were the last thing anyone sent up.

gateways.name: The Prospectors' Cut
gateways.notes: Found by Ironhead prospectors. Two companies have filed property rights over the shaft, neither claim struck out. Nobody has gone past the first chamber.

territories.name: Sumptown
territories.boon: Recruit one Juve free each Downtime
territories.notes: Barge wharves and a century of silt. Everything coming down from above lands here first.

territories.name: The Chokestack
territories.boon: Free Brute hire this cycle
territories.notes: The furnace still runs. Nobody admits to lighting it and nobody dares let it go out.

territories.name: The Glass Dome
territories.boon: Clean water: ignore one Lasting Injury roll
territories.notes: A cracked crystalflex dome over a working still. The Chymists moved in and the water got stranger.

territories.name: The Still Rows
territories.boon: One free chem or toxin weapon upgrade
territories.notes: Condensers in rows the length of a dome. Sola Dosis insists the fumes are therapeutic.

territories.name: Relay Station Theta
territories.boon: Reroll one Intelligence test per battle
territories.notes: The Tech-Acquisitor party staged out of Theta. Their last transmission was a set of coordinates and nothing else.

territories.name: The Brass Gallery
territories.boon: Rare trade roll at +1 when buying archeotech
territories.notes: Three hundred metres of sealed brass doors. Team 3 has opened eleven and will not discuss the twelfth.

territories.name: Cinder Yard
territories.boon: Extra D6x10 credits if held two cycles running
territories.notes: Ash heaps that shift without warning. Three gangs are still down there somewhere.

territories.name: Grudgehold
territories.boon: Defender deploys one free fortification
territories.notes: Cut into the rock and ledgered to the last slate. Bjorn filed the claim first and has the paperwork to prove it.

territories.name: Holestead
territories.boon: Hangers-on cost 20 credits less
territories.notes: Company housing, company store, company arbitration. Resource Extraction filed second and disputes that it matters.

territories.name: The Scrap Shoals
territories.boon: Sell scrap: +D3x10 credits each Downtime
territories.notes: Quarterly extraction targets are posted at the gate. Somebody has been correcting them in blood.

territories.name: Precinct House 22
territories.boon: One free Palanite patrol escort each Downtime
territories.notes: Built to hold two hundred. Currently holds nineteen, a vox relay and a great deal of institutional stubbornness.

territories.name: The Pit Market
territories.boon: Rare trade roll at +2
territories.notes: Neutral ground by long tradition. Precinct 22 enforces that tradition at gunpoint, which everyone agrees is novel.

territories.name: The Sunken Nave
territories.boon: Reroll one Leadership test per battle
territories.notes: Cawdor built it, something else kept it. Mycelium Section took the crypts and left the nave to the candles.

territories.name: Ratgut Tunnels
territories.boon: Move freely between territories you hold
territories.notes: Not mapped, not mappable. Mycelium Section claims otherwise and charges for guides.

territories.name: Rustfall Row
territories.boon: Search the ruins: one free Common item
territories.notes: Collapsed habs stacked nine deep. The footing is a liability and the snipers know it.

territories.name: The Coil Gardens
territories.boon: One free flamer-class weapon
territories.notes: Pipework grown into a thicket. Van Saar say they understand it. They do not.

territories.name: Vent Nine
territories.boon: Infiltrate: one fighter deploys hidden
territories.notes: The up-hive draught comes through here. So does anything that wants in quietly.

territories.name: The Drowned Stair
territories.boon: Scavenge: D3 free Common items
territories.notes: The stairs go down into the sump and keep going. Low tide reveals about forty more steps.

territories.name: The Weeping Wall
territories.boon: Defender gains one extra barricade
territories.notes: Groundwater bleeds through the rockcrete in sheets. The sound carries for a kilometre.

territories.name: The Black Ledger
territories.boon: Wager credits before a battle
territories.notes: Debts here are recorded in a real book. People have died trying to edit it.

territories.name: The Bonepipe
territories.boon: One free medical escort each Downtime
territories.notes: The doc is good. The doc is also why several gangers answer to new names.

territories.name: The Wire Yard
territories.boon: One free weapon upgrade each Downtime
territories.notes: Spools of cable taller than a Goliath. Whoever untangles it first gets rich or gets cut in half.
